title: Offline, intermittent network and retry-safe channel behavior
workflow: Detect connection loss and display source freshness explicitly
Protect or purge restricted cached data per risk and legal policy
Permit only approved local draft/nonfinancial operations
On reconnect, reauthenticate, reauthorize, reprice and revalidate drafts
Assign stable idempotency identity before server submission
Display confirmed server outcome separately from local queue or transport response
invariants: Offline draft never changes authoritative account balance
Cached transfer confirmation cannot bypass step-up after reconnect
A queued request is not an accepted bank payment
No automatic replay on unknown external settlement outcome
Sensitive storage and credentials remain under institution device controls
Resubmission must use one stable financial command ID
Stale exchange rates/fees require fresh approved quote before authorization
acceptance_tests: Offline draft not shown as completed transfer
Stale fee quote cannot silently execute
Unresolved external response is not retried blindly
independent_gate: Bank offline/device policy, payment domain idempotency and executed network-fault tests.
